newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal called $1-$2 lower, oil off 0.10 cts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal called $1-$2 lower, oil off 0.10 cts.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures were seen opening down $1.00 to $2.00 a ton while soyoil was expected to be off around 0.10 cent a lb following calls for a lower opening on CBOT soybeans.

Dealers noted USDA had increased its estimate for the U.S. crush this year by five million bushels to 1.425 million while soybean imports were also seen five million bushels higher at 10 million. CBOT soybeans were seen opening two to four cents a bushel lower.
